title: `teploy backup create --json`: the created backup's identity (backup-json-v1, rev 14).

size_bytes.description: Size of the uploaded volumes archive or engine dump. 0 when the size could not be stated (the backup itself succeeded).

created_at.description: RFC3339 UTC derived from the backup id's timestamp.

teploy_key.description: Sibling object holding the app's server config/history (volume backups only, when present).

pruned.description: Backups removed by the requested retention policy after the upload.
